To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the BACS efficiency class 1 has the best energy efficiency in respect to the EN 152 32 standard, however, the BACS efficiency factor 1.1 (lighting control) is not the most efficient one.
the building automation control system has a positive impact on the building energy efficiency.
the BACS efficiency class 3 is more efficient than BACS efficiency class2.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact of building automation control on the energy efficiency in the university building.
the impact of the automation systems on the building energy efficiency.
the evaluation of the BACS efficiency in a real university building case study.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
BACS and TMB are very important and useful tools in energy efficiency improvement.
the BACS efficiency is strongly dependent on the building infrastructure and on the way the system is used.
the building automation control systems with higher efficiency class can improve the energy efficiency of the university classroom.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the BACS efficiency classes defined in EN 15232 are useful to assess the impact of building automation control system on the energy efficiency, however, there is need for further research on the factors that influence the BACS efficiency class.
the building automation systems can be a useful tool for the energy efficiency improvement.
BACS efficiency factors are not the same as BACS efficiency class, and BACS efficiency class is not the same as the BACS energy efficiency.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is no direct correlation between the BACS and the building energy consumption.
the energy efficiency of the building automation system depends on the building automation control system efficiency class.
the BACS and the TBM efficiency classes are not sufficient to describe the energy efficiency of a building.
